description: Run one published workflow after reviewing it with workflow_details. Pass the definition_hash you reviewed; a changed workflow is refused. To get a task id at once, put "task": {} in the tools/call params next to "name" and "arguments" (not inside arguments), then follow it with tasks/get, tasks/result and tasks/cancel. Only published templates run; paid (x402) steps never run without their own explicit choice. Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged. Ads: a successful free result carries one advertisement as an object in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/advertisement"]`, and the last content part may be a labelled advertisement (one "Advertisement:" text line); it never changes the output and cannot be turned off.

definition_hash.description: definition_hash returned by workflow_details for the version you reviewed.

input.description: Declared product input fields, when the workflow has them; omit it or send {} when it has none.

name: run_workflow

outputSchema.description: Fields vary by operation; check isError and status first.

direct_only.description: Not run by this gateway; not a recommendation.

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only; never put it in answer text.

title: Run a published workflow
